results.rationale: Consistency: excluding both temple arms, the tabletop, diagonal grain, lighting and glasses placement remain consistent, but the front frame/nose-pad assembly is visibly redrawn with darker, more defined pad fittings. Instruction: a rounded extension has been added to the truncated lower arm; a complete result would have a continuous arm joined smoothly to its existing shaft. The extension addresses the request but leaves a conspicuous notch/gap at the join, so completion is partial. Quality: texture and lighting are satisfactory, but structural coherence and artifact freedom are problematic at the visibly broken-looking lower-arm joint.

Consistency: excluding fruit maturation, the leafy branch setting is retained, but the framing is tighter and leaf contours, veins and surface texture have noticeably changed. Instruction: the two prominent pale-green fruits become orange-red and rounder; the expected mature appearance is largely present, although several partially visible fruits remain green. Knowledge: the supplied explanation says persimmons should turn red. The prominent fruits now have reddish-orange ripe coloration, matching the stated maturation logic, with a minor omission in the still-green background fruits. Quality: structural coherence, natural lighting and perspective, artifact freedom and surface textures are satisfactory; fruits, calyxes, branch and leaves form a coherent scene without noticeable defects.
